# Celestial Echoes of Eternity
## Scripture
"For since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities—his eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made, so that people are without excuse." - Romans 1:20

## Reflection
As we gaze up at the starry night sky, we're reminded of the eternal nature of God. The celestial bodies, suspended in space, echo the timeless and unchanging character of our Creator. Just as the stars and planets continue to orbit and shine, unaffected by the passage of time, God's power and divine nature remain constant and unshakeable. This realization invites us to reflect on our own place within the grand tapestry of God's creation, and to consider the eternal implications of our faith. As we ponder the mysteries of the universe, we're drawn into a deeper understanding of God's eternal plan, and our role within it.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, thank you for the celestial echoes that remind us of your eternal nature. Help us to grasp the timeless and unchanging character of your power and divine nature. As we gaze up at the stars, may we be filled with a sense of awe and wonder, and may our hearts be drawn into a deeper understanding of your eternal plan. May we live with eternal purpose, knowing that our lives are a part of your grand tapestry. In Jesus' name, we pray, amen.
